t: The sculpture in front of you is called Roundhouse, by Joel Perlman. Perlman is an American sculptor, born in 1943, and he is the artist who made this work. The title points to a rounded form, so notice the shapes and how they move as you walk around it. I don't have more detail on when it was installed or what it's made from, so rather than fill the gap, I'll leave you to look closely and enjoy how the piece sits in the space around it.
